subject: Lounge: ledges, rail, beams and rugs; the Sun reaches the passengers

views.about: the cabin shot (space/lounge.ts, render/lounge.ts, render/passengers.ts): Start after 25 s on the title (the passengers loaded behind it), then from the lounge under the nose looking out of the window that faces the port face, past the passengers in their couches, as the ship creeps in along its berth arm (-in, -mid, -late, the arm and face nearer); lit by its lamps, by the bright view out and by the Sun through the glass; logs the arrival and loading lines
